pages.title: The Mana Beacon
pages.text: A beacon that burns mana instead of a pyramid. Feed it from a $(l)Mana Battery$() (by conduits, or placed beside one) and it blesses every player within $(l)24 blocks$().$(br2)A light rises from it while it works. Right-click with an empty hand to see what it's doing.

pages.title: Choosing a Blessing
pages.text: Right-click the beacon with an item to tune it. The item is $(l)not$() used up.$(li)$(item)Sugar$(): Swiftness$(li)$(item)Gold Ingot$(): Haste$(li)$(item)Iron Ingot$(): Resistance$(li)$(item)Rabbit's Foot$(): Leaping$(li)$(item)Golden Carrot$(): Night Vision$(li)$(item)Ghast Tear$(): Regeneration$(li)$(item)Amethyst Shard$(): $(#9b5de5)Wellspring$()

pages.title: Costs
pages.text: Every 4 seconds it spends $(l)3 mana per player$() in range, and nothing at all when no one is near.$(br2)$(#9b5de5)Wellspring$() pours mana straight into nearby mages instead: 2 mana every 4 seconds, on top of their own regeneration.
